title: Use of Shockwave M5+/L6 IVL Catheter (Intravascular Lithotripsy) in Hostile and Calcified Iliac Access
official: No-profit, Pilot, Observational, Multicentric, Prospective Study on the Use of Shockwave M5+/L6 IVL Catheter (Intravascular Lithotripsy) in Hostile and Calcified Iliac Access to Facilitate Aortic Endovascular Repair. SHOCK-ACCESS STUDY.
summary: The study will evaluate, in a controlled setting, the efficacy and safety of the intravascular lithotripsy using Shockwave™ M5+/L6 Peripheral Intravascular Lithotripsy Catheter to facilitate delivery of aortic large-bore devices in iliac calcified access.

sites.f: Ospedale Santa Maria della Misericordia di Perugia
